items.html: But the Essence is clothed both in the ten Sefirot called 'world' and in the ten Sefirot called 'Nefashot and Ruchin', etc. Only that the Essence of the Nefashot and Ruchin will be greater than the Essence clothed in the world itself. (Or it is possible that the aspect of the Essence is only what is within the Nefashot and Ruchin, etc., which are the aspects of the parts of the vessels of Atzilut that are clothed there, as stated above. But that which is in the ten Sefirot of the externality called 'world' — even the Essence within them is not in the aspect of the Essence of the vessels of Atzilut, but is a spirituality of one of the aspects of that world, and it requires further thought.) And it is found that there is Ibur, Yenika, and Mochin for the externality, which is the ten Sefirot called 'world', and Ibur, Yenika, and Mochin for the ten Sefirot called 'man'.
